facts.text: Nimban was a Hutt Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Nimbanel species.

evidence.quote: Nimban was a Hutt Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Nimbanel species.

facts.text: Having evolved from herbivorous reptiles that had tracked moving plants across Nimban's plains, the Nimbanese preferred an intellectual approach to problem-solving instead of violence and excelled at dealing with bureaucracies.

evidence.quote: Having evolved from herbivorous reptiles that had tracked moving plants across Nimban's plains, the Nimbanese preferred an intellectual approach to problem-solving instead of violence and excelled at dealing with bureaucracies.

facts.text: Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire by 25,102 BBY, and the Nimbanese played an important role in the foundation of the galactic Bureau of Ships and Services around 18,000 BBY.

evidence.quote: Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire by 25,102 BBY, and the Nimbanese played an important role in the foundation of the galactic Bureau of Ships and Services around 18,000 BBY.

facts.text: Nimban eventually became a member world of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Nimban eventually became a member world of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Centuries before the Galactic Civil War, however, the Nimbanese Krovalis clan led the species and their homeworld into seceding from the Republic and petitioning the Hutt clans to voluntarily become a part of Hutt Space and enter servitude to the Hutt species.

evidence.quote: Centuries before the Galactic Civil War, however, the Nimbanese Krovalis clan led the species and their homeworld into seceding from the Republic and petitioning the Hutt clans to voluntarily become a part of Hutt Space and enter servitude to the Hutt species.

facts.text: By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Nimban was the site of the headquarters of the companies Delban Faxicorp and Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. The Yuuzhan Vong eventually conquered the Nimban system as part of their invasion of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Nimban was the site of the headquarters of the companies Delban Faxicorp and Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. The Yuuzhan Vong eventually conquered the Nimban system as part of their invasion of the galaxy.

facts.text: Nimban was a planet located in the Nimban system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice.

evidence.quote: Nimban was a planet located in the Nimban system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice.

facts.text: The length of Nimban's local year was three fifths of a standard year, and the planet's surface featured nine continents.

evidence.quote: The length of Nimban's local year was three fifths of a standard year, and the planet's surface featured nine continents.

facts.text: A very gentle and peaceful world, Nimban had a peculiar ecology wherein a species of grazing reptile that was at one point at the top of the Nimbanese food chain tracked unusual plants that were traveling across the planet's plains.

evidence.quote: A very gentle and peaceful world, Nimban had a peculiar ecology wherein a species of grazing reptile that was at one point at the top of the Nimbanese food chain tracked unusual plants that were traveling across the planet's plains.

facts.text: Those plants evolved progressively more sophisticated means of protecting their seeds, while the reptiles—which eventually evolved into the sentient Nimbanel species—adapted in order to extract the plants' edible portions.

evidence.quote: Those plants evolved progressively more sophisticated means of protecting their seeds, while the reptiles—which eventually evolved into the sentient Nimbanel species—adapted in order to extract the plants' edible portions.

facts.text: Thus, the Nimbanese began to craft tools to reach the boyy'lo plant's berries and developed analytical skills in order to unlock the interlocking petals of the puzzleflower.

evidence.quote: Thus, the Nimbanese began to craft tools to reach the boyy'lo plant's berries and developed analytical skills in order to unlock the interlocking petals of the puzzleflower.

facts.text: Nimban was also home to the creature known as the jowlpreener.

evidence.quote: Nimban was also home to the creature known as the jowlpreener.

facts.text: By 25,102 BBY, Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire, and merchants of the planet's native Nimbanel species served masters of the Hutt species offworld during that time.

evidence.quote: By 25,102 BBY, Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire, and merchants of the planet's native Nimbanel species served masters of the Hutt species offworld during that time.

facts.text: After the Nimbanese were discovered by the Galactic Republic, they became instrumental in founding the Bureau of Ships and Services, a supragovernmental galactic starship regulation agency, around 18,000 BBY.
entities: The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)

evidence.quote: After the Nimbanese were discovered by the Galactic Republic, they became instrumental in founding the Bureau of Ships and Services, a supragovernmental galactic starship regulation agency, around 18,000 BBY.

facts.text: Although the Republic explored space surrounding Nimban between 15,000 BBY and 8000 BBY, the planet was situated outside of both the Republic's and Hutt Space's borders between around 15,000 BBY and approximately 11,000 BBY.

evidence.quote: Although the Republic explored space surrounding Nimban between 15,000 BBY and 8000 BBY, the planet was situated outside of both the Republic's and Hutt Space's borders between around 15,000 BBY and approximately 11,000 BBY.

facts.text: In 11,939 BBY, the military forces of the Republic, which was controlled by the Humanocentric Pius Dea sect at the time, advanced toward Nimban as part of the Third Pius Dea Crusade that was waged against the Hutt species.

evidence.quote: In 11,939 BBY, the military forces of the Republic, which was controlled by the Humanocentric Pius Dea sect at the time, advanced toward Nimban as part of the Third Pius Dea Crusade that was waged against the Hutt species.

facts.text: Nimban eventually became a member world of the Republic with representatives in the Galactic Senate.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: Nimban eventually became a member world of the Republic with representatives in the Galactic Senate.

facts.text: However, by several centuries before the Galactic Civil War, the Nimbanese had observed the encroachment of Hutt Space upon their territory.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: However, by several centuries before the Galactic Civil War, the Nimbanese had observed the encroachment of Hutt Space upon their territory.

facts.text: The Nimbanese Krovalis clan had applied to become a data holder family of the Bureau of Ships and Services and approached the Hutt clans, offering its species' servitude as well as complete access to the Nimbanese databanks and holdings.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: The Nimbanese Krovalis clan had applied to become a data holder family of the Bureau of Ships and Services and approached the Hutt clans, offering its species' servitude as well as complete access to the Nimbanese databanks and holdings.

facts.text: Thus, Nimban seceded from the Republic and successfully petitioned to become a part of Hutt Space at some point by 22 BBY, a decision that brought the world galactic renown.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: Thus, Nimban seceded from the Republic and successfully petitioned to become a part of Hutt Space at some point by 22 BBY, a decision that brought the world galactic renown.

facts.text: Nevertheless, during the first campaigns of the Clone Wars that year, the Republic's Thirteenth Sector Army was tasked with engaging the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in Nimban's vicinity.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: Nevertheless, during the first campaigns of the Clone Wars that year, the Republic's Thirteenth Sector Army was tasked with engaging the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in Nimban's vicinity.

facts.text: At some point between 26 ABY and 27 ABY, the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nimban system as part of their invasion of the galaxy.

evidence.section: History > Joining and leaving the Republic
evidence.quote: At some point between 26 ABY and 27 ABY, the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nimban system as part of their invasion of the galaxy.

facts.text: All Nimbanese spoke the Nimbanese language as well as the Huttese language of the Hutt species and Galactic Basic Standard, the lingua franca of the wider galaxy.

evidence.quote: All Nimbanese spoke the Nimbanese language as well as the Huttese language of the Hutt species and Galactic Basic Standard, the lingua franca of the wider galaxy.

facts.text: The population of the Nimban system around 25 ABY numbered between one and ten billion.

evidence.quote: The population of the Nimban system around 25 ABY numbered between one and ten billion.

facts.text: The Nimbanese society was organized into clan states that eventually spread across all of Nimban's continents, and since early in the species' history, clan rivalries were resolved through puzzle competitions known as muhndees.

evidence.quote: The Nimbanese society was organized into clan states that eventually spread across all of Nimban's continents, and since early in the species' history, clan rivalries were resolved through puzzle competitions known as muhndees.
